reasoning_content: `oneshot_run` first sets `f="$1"` (unit name, e.g., `qisutu-install-complete.service`), then executes `sed -n ... "$f"` — but `$f` is not a file. We need `f="$(unit_file "$1")"`. Fixing line by line: `local f="$1" svc base` → `local f svc base` and `f="$(unit_file "$1")"`.

action.command: cd /usr/local/bin && python3 2>/dev/null; sed -i 's|    local f="$1" svc base|    local f svc base\n    f="$(unit_file "$1")"|' systemctl && sed -n '/^oneshot_run/,/^}/p' systemctl && bash -n systemctl && echo SYNTAX_OK

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /usr/local/bin && python3 2>/dev/null; sed -i 's|    local f=\"$1\" svc base|    local f svc base\\n    f=\"$(unit_file \"$1\")\"|' systemctl && sed -n '/^oneshot_run/,/^}/p' systemctl && bash -n systemctl && echo SYNTAX_OK", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Fix oneshot_run to use unit_file"}
